capabilities: Sync a vault with a pCloud folder in both directions
Detect changed files via the pCloud change feed instead of listing the whole vault
Keep both versions when the same note changes on two devices and send deletions to trash
Trigger sync on app open, after typing pauses, and before switching apps on mobile
Halt and ask before a sync would remove a large part of the vault
extras: Free and open source; no servers or analytics (files go directly between Obsidian and the pCloud API). Known limits: files over 20 MB skipped on mobile (200 MB on desktop), .obsidian settings not synced yet, pCloud Crypto folders unsupported, no end-to-end encryption; automatic Markdown conflict merging and opt-in settings sync are planned. Requires a pCloud access token that grants account-wide access. Sync engine is written in Rust compiled to WebAssembly.
intentEvidence: Is Cumulus an alternative to Obsidian Sync? Yes, if you already store your notes in pCloud.
motivation: The author wrote it for the common situation where a vault lives in pCloud and works on the computer through pCloud Drive, but Obsidian on the phone cannot open it.
problem: Obsidian on mobile cannot open vaults stored in pCloud because pCloud does not expose its folders as a regular file system, so vaults that live in pCloud have no way to sync to phones.

relations.evidence: Is Cumulus an alternative to Obsidian Sync? Yes, if you already store your notes in pCloud.
Cumulus uses the official pCloud API, not WebDAV (which requires a paid plan).

summary: Two-way sync plugin that keeps an Obsidian vault in sync with a folder in the user's pCloud account on Android, iOS and desktop.
